content.summary: Learning-centred secondary teacher with 9 years of experience designing inclusive English and literature instruction, mentoring learners, and using assessment evidence to improve outcomes.

experience.title: Senior Teacher, English
bullets: Designed differentiated literature units that improved average end-of-year examination scores by 18%.
Led a peer-reading programme for 160 learners, increasing voluntary library participation by 43%.
Mentored six early-career teachers through lesson observation and practical feedback cycles.

experience.title: Teacher of English
bullets: Created formative assessment routines that identified and supported 47 learners at risk of falling behind.
Coordinated debate and creative-writing clubs that represented the school in regional competitions.
